name: Verify event-log lineage before lifecycle mutations
goal: Guard every lifecycle mutation (expedition approve, commit, start, finish, complete, archive, cancel) against forking the derived event log across branches: before mutating, compare the current branch's .synth/data/event-log.jsonl against the richest known log among local refs and origin/main; accept when it is a strict prefix (stale-but-safe, matching the proven fast-forward-before-finish protocol from investigation 3c84f699a7c932fc), block or warn when other refs carry exclusive events the current log lacks, and print reconciliation guidance (fast-forward when ancestor, explicit merge order otherwise). Implement in the CLI pre-flight layer, not inside the ExecutionGate, which stays untouched
